claims.statement: Atlas is a Greek Titan punished by Zeus to hold up the heavens.
claims.statement_id: Atlas adalah Titan Yunani yang dihukum Zeus untuk menopang langit.
claims.quote: In Greek mythology, the Titan Atlas was responsible for bearing the weight of the heavens on his shoulders, a burden given to him as punishment by Zeus.

claims.statement: Atlas is a son of Iapetus and Clymene or Themis and brother of Prometheus.
claims.statement_id: Atlas adalah putra Iapetus dan Clymene atau Themis, serta saudara Prometheus.
claims.quote: Atlas was the son of the Titans Iapetus and Clymene (or Themis) and the elder brother of Epimetheus, Menoetius, and Prometheus.

claims.statement: Atlas was punished for leading the Titans against the Olympian gods.
claims.statement_id: Atlas dihukum karena memimpin para Titan melawan dewa Olimpus.
claims.quote: Atlas was given the task of holding up the heavens as punishment from Zeus for leading the Titans in their battle with the Olympian Gods for control of the heavens.

claims.statement: Hesiod locates Atlas in the land of the Hesperides holding up the heavens.
claims.statement_id: Hesiod menempatkan Atlas di tanah Hesperides sambil menopang langit.
claims.quote: Hesiod in his Theogony also describes Atlas as holding up the heavens and locates him in the land of the Hesperides

claims.statement: Hercules asked Atlas to fetch the Hesperides' apples while temporarily taking his burden.
claims.statement_id: Hercules meminta Atlas mengambil apel Hesperides dan sementara menggantikan bebannya.
claims.quote: Following the advice of Prometheus, Hercules asked Atlas (in some versions the father of the Hesperides) to get him the apples while he, with the help of Athena, took the world onto his shoulders for a while

claims.statement: Hercules tricked Atlas into resuming his burden.
claims.statement_id: Hercules menipu Atlas agar kembali menanggung bebannya.
claims.quote: However, the wily Hercules tricked the god into swapping places temporarily while the hero got himself some cushions to more easily bear the tremendous weight.

claims.statement: Traditions say Atlas guarded heaven's pillars or held up the sky.
claims.statement_id: Ada tradisi yang menyebut Atlas menjaga tiang langit atau menopang langit.
claims.quote: As punishment he was forced to guard the pillars of heaven or to hold up the sky itself.

claims.statement: In another account, Perseus turned Atlas into a mountain with Medusa's head.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi lain, Perseus mengubah Atlas menjadi gunung batu dengan kepala Medusa.
claims.quote: It was here that, in punishment for his gross lack of hospitality, the Titan was transformed from a shepherd into a huge rock mountain by Perseus using the head of the Gorgon Medusa with her deadly stare.

claims.statement: Hellenistic and Roman art depicts Atlas straining to hold a globe on his shoulders.
claims.statement_id: Seni Helenistik dan Romawi menggambarkan Atlas membungkuk menahan bola di bahunya.
claims.quote: In Hellenistic and Roman times, Atlas is frequently represented in his now familiar position with bent knees and back, straining to hold the globe on his shoulders.

claims.statement: Cerberus is a three-headed dog guarding the underworld entrance in Greek mythology.
claims.statement_id: Cerberus adalah anjing berkepala tiga penjaga pintu dunia bawah dalam mitologi Yunani.
claims.quote: Cerberus (also spelt Kerberos) is a vicious three-headed dog in Greek mythology, who guards the entrance to the underworld.

claims.statement: Cerberus seized those who tried to escape the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Cerberus menangkap mereka yang mencoba keluar dari dunia bawah.
claims.quote: He allowed all to enter, but seized those who attempted to escape.

claims.statement: Cerberus is the child of Typhon and Echidna.
claims.statement_id: Cerberus adalah anak Typhon dan Echidna.
claims.quote: Cerberus is a son of Typhon, a Giant, and Echidna, a half-woman, half-snake creature.

claims.statement: Cerberus was known as the Hound of Hades.
claims.statement_id: Cerberus dikenal sebagai anjing Hades.
claims.quote: As a faithful companion to Hades, king of the underworld and god of the dead, Cerberus was known as the 'Hound of Hades'

claims.statement: Hesiod described Cerberus as having fifty heads.
claims.statement_id: Hesiod menggambarkan Cerberus berkepala lima puluh.
claims.quote: According to Hesiod (Theog. 311), he was a fifty-headed monster with a fearful bark

claims.statement: Depictions vary in head count and may give Cerberus a snake tail.
claims.statement_id: Penggambaran Cerberus berbeda dalam jumlah kepala dan dapat memiliki ekor ular.
claims.quote: He was variously represented with one, two or (usually) three heads, often with the tail of a snake or with snakes growing from his head or twined round his body.

claims.statement: Hercules's twelfth labor was to bring Cerberus out of Tartarus.
claims.statement_id: Tugas kedua belas Hercules adalah membawa Cerberus keluar dari Tartarus.
claims.quote: The twelfth and last labour was the most dangerous one yet. Hercules had to bring Cerberus up from Tartarus.

claims.statement: Hades allowed Hercules to take Cerberus if he subdued him without weapons.
claims.statement_id: Hades mengizinkan Hercules membawa Cerberus bila mengalahkannya tanpa senjata.
claims.quote: Hades replied that Hercules could have him if he could overpower him without using any weapons.

claims.statement: Hercules returned Cerberus to Hades after presenting him to Eurystheus.
claims.statement_id: Hercules mengembalikan Cerberus kepada Hades setelah menunjukkannya kepada Eurystheus.
claims.quote: After presenting Cerberus to King Eurystheus, Hercules returned him to Hades.

claims.statement: Orpheus charmed Cerberus with his lyre in the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Orpheus memikat Cerberus dengan liranya saat turun ke dunia bawah.
claims.quote: Once he had arrived in Hades, he used his lyre to bewitch Charon, Cerberus, and the three Judges of the Dead

claims.statement: Fairy refers to supernatural beings said to interfere magically in human affairs.
claims.statement_id: Fairy adalah istilah bagi makhluk gaib yang dalam cerita turut campur secara ajaib dalam urusan manusia.
claims.quote: the common term for a supposed race of supernatural beings who magically intermeddle in human affairs.

claims.statement: Fairies appear in old British and Irish folk narratives.
claims.statement_id: Fairy tampil dalam cerita rakyat lama Britania dan Irlandia.
claims.quote: Discover the intriguing, formidable faeries of old British and Irish folk narratives.

claims.statement: Fairy size and type vary among local stories.
claims.statement_id: Ukuran dan jenis fairy berbeda menurut kisah setempat.
claims.quote: Split between numerous local species, ranging from full-sized Scottish elf-queens to small, wizened male house fairies, they share a number of common characteristics.

claims.statement: In British and Irish tales, fairies are immortal and can vanish, shapeshift, or create illusions.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita Britania dan Irlandia, fairy bersifat abadi dan dapat menghilang, berubah wujud, atau menciptakan ilusi.
claims.quote: All are immortal, with supernatural powers that include vanishing, shape-shifting and creating illusions.

claims.statement: Fairies may be dangerous or benevolent depending on human conduct in stories.
claims.statement_id: Fairy dapat berbahaya atau baik hati tergantung perlakuan manusia dalam cerita.
claims.quote: They are typically capricious, dangerous and vengeful, though may display benevolence so long as great care is taken not to offend them by breaking their curious protocols.

claims.statement: Fairy stories include child abduction and changeling substitution.
claims.statement_id: Cerita fairy memuat penculikan anak dan penggantian dengan changeling.
claims.quote: They carry off children, leaving changeling substitutes, transport men and women into fairyland

claims.statement: In older stories some fairies fly without wings.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita lama, sebagian fairy terbang tanpa sayap.
claims.quote: Though some can fly, they do not have wings, but levitate by mounting twigs, bundles of grass or plant stems, wearing a special cap or uttering a set of potent words.

claims.statement: Fairy lore has been studied in Folklore since the late nineteenth century.
claims.statement_id: Cerita fairy telah diteliti dalam jurnal Folklore sejak akhir abad ke-19.
claims.quote: fairy lore has provided a fruitful area of investigation for contributors to the journal Folklore since its founding in the late nineteenth century.

claims.statement: Some Irish and Scottish fairies are described as ordinary human size.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian peri Irlandia dan Skotlandia digambarkan setinggi manusia biasa.
claims.quote: The “people of peace” (Daoine Shie) of Ireland and Scotland are usually of ordinary stature, indeed not to be recognized as varying from mankind except by their proceedings

claims.statement: The griffin is a hybrid with an eagle's head and wings and a lion's body.
claims.statement_id: Griffin adalah makhluk campuran berkepala dan bersayap elang serta bertubuh singa.
claims.quote: THE GRYPS (Griffin) was a beast with the head and wings of an eagle and the body of a lion.

claims.statement: In Greek accounts, griffins guarded gold in the mountains of Scythia.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Yunani, griffin menjaga emas di pegunungan Skithia.
claims.quote: A tribe of the creatures guarded rich deposits of gold in the mountains of Skythia (Scythia) in north-eastern Europe.

claims.statement: The one-eyed Arimaspians were said to fight griffins for gold.
claims.statement_id: Arimaspian bermata satu dikisahkan memperebutkan emas dengan griffin.
claims.quote: Their one-eyed neighbours, the Arimaspians, battled them for these riches.

claims.statement: Griffins appeared in ancient Greek art and later in medieval bestiaries and heraldry.
claims.statement_id: Sosok griffin hadir dalam seni Yunani kuno, bestiari, dan heraldik abad pertengahan.
claims.quote: Decorative griffins were popular in ancient Greek art and later in medieval bestiaries and heraldry.

claims.statement: The griffin was a favored motif on ancient Greek bronze vessels.
claims.statement_id: Griffin menjadi motif hias yang disukai pada perunggu Yunani kuno.
claims.quote: The griffin—a fantastic beast with the body of a lion and the head of an eagle—and the sphinx—with a feline body and a human head—were favorite motifs

claims.statement: On a throne leg documented by the Met, the griffin served as a symbol of royalty.
claims.statement_id: Pada kaki takhta yang dicatat The Met, griffin melambangkan kekuasaan kerajaan.
claims.quote: The griffin on this throne leg exemplifies the use of powerful winged animals (real and imaginary) as symbols of royalty.

claims.statement: Griffin imagery appeared in Egyptian and Middle Eastern art around 3000 BCE.
claims.statement_id: Motif griffin telah muncul dalam seni Mesir dan Timur Tengah sekitar 3000 SM.
claims.quote: The mythical beast’s long history stretches back to about 3000 B.C., when it appeared in the art of Egypt and the Middle East

claims.statement: In pre-Islamic Iran the griffin was understood as a vehicle of ascension.
claims.statement_id: Di Iran pra-Islam, griffin dipandang sebagai lambang kenaikan status.
claims.quote: In pre-Islamic Iran the griffin—a combination of lion and eagle, two animals associated with the sun—was seen as a vehicle of ascension

claims.statement: Pausanias described griffins as lion-like beasts with eagle beaks and wings.
claims.statement_id: Pausanias menggambarkan griffin seperti singa dengan paruh dan sayap elang.
claims.quote: Grypas are beasts like lions, but with the beak and wings of an eagle.

claims.statement: Written accounts of the Tibetan Yeti legend date to the twelfth century.
claims.statement_id: Legenda Yeti dalam tradisi Tibet tercatat sejak abad ke-12.
claims.quote: Written accounts of the Tibetan legend of the Yeti date back to the 12th century.

claims.statement: Some accounts portray the yeti as a reddish-brown-haired, ape-like biped.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian kisah menggambarkan Yeti sebagai sosok mirip kera berbulu cokelat kemerahan yang berjalan dengan dua kaki.
claims.quote: Also called a "wild man," many accounts describe the creature as an ape-like being, over six feet tall, walking on its back legs, with reddish-brown fur covering its muscular body.

claims.statement: Tibetan tradition has two-legged yetis and larger four-legged ones said to prey on livestock.
claims.statement_id: Tradisi Tibet mengenal variasi Yeti berkaki dua dan bentuk lebih besar berkaki empat yang memangsa ternak.
claims.quote: Tibetan tradition recognizes a variety of Yeti, one said to walk on two legs, and another larger Yeti that preys on livestock and walks on four legs.

claims.statement: In the stories, yetis are believed to inhabit alpine forests below the snow line.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita, Yeti dipercaya menghuni hutan alpin di bawah garis salju.
claims.quote: Yeti are believed to live in the alpine forest below the snow line, although they will brave higher altitude for food and shelter.

claims.statement: In many stories, the yeti is nocturnal and makes a high-pitched whistle or screech.
claims.statement_id: Dalam banyak cerita, Yeti aktif pada malam hari dan mengeluarkan siulan atau jeritan bernada tinggi.
claims.quote: In many stories, the Yeti is nocturnal, and emits a high-pitched screech or whistle.

claims.statement: Tibetan Buddhist stories feature both kind and malevolent yetis.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Buddhis Tibet, Yeti dapat tampil baik ataupun jahat.
claims.quote: Tibetan Buddhist stories feature Yetis as both kind and malevolent characters.

claims.statement: The white-furred film depiction lacks folkloric support before the twentieth century.
claims.statement_id: Gambaran Yeti berbulu putih yang lazim dalam film tidak didukung cerita rakyat sebelum abad ke-20.
claims.quote: But there's no real folklore that supports that version before the 20th century.

claims.statement: Mitochondrial DNA analysis of purported yeti samples supported their identification as local bears.
claims.statement_id: Analisis DNA mitokondria atas sampel yang diklaim sebagai Yeti mendukung identifikasi sampel itu sebagai beruang lokal.
claims.quote: Phylogenetic analyses of mitochondrial DNA sequences determined clade affinities of the purported yeti samples in this study, strongly supporting the biological basis of the yeti legend to be local, extant bears.

claims.statement: Researchers associate the yeti legend with local bears while acknowledging uncertainty around the wider stories.
claims.statement_id: Kajian ilmiah mengaitkan kisah Yeti dengan beruang setempat, tetapi identitas seluruh kisah tentang sosok mirip manusia tetap diperdebatkan.
claims.quote: Although anecdotally associated with local bears (Ursus arctos and U. thibetanus), the exact identity of ‘hominid’-like creatures important to folklore and mythology in the Tibetan Plateau–Himalaya region is still surrounded by mystery.

claims.statement: Reports of purported yeti footprints spurred Western climbers' interest in the 1950s.
claims.statement_id: Laporan jejak yang diklaim sebagai Yeti memicu minat pendaki Barat pada 1950-an.
claims.quote: Believed by some to live in the Himalayan Mountains, interest in the Yeti spiked during the 1950s, when Western climbers ascending Mount Everest reported Yeti footprints.

claims.statement: Nepal issued rules for yeti-seeking expeditions.
claims.statement_id: Pemerintah Nepal pernah mengeluarkan aturan bagi ekspedisi pencarian Yeti.
claims.quote: This prompted the government of Nepal to issue regulations for Yeti-hunting expeditions
